# Jeralmi Canela

> Jeralmi Canela (also known as Jeralmics) is a game developer. Personal site: https://jeralmics.com/

Jeralmi studies computer science and loves making things in just about any form; games are what Jeralmi keeps coming back to. Jeralmi works on every part of them (programming, 3D in Blender, building in Unreal Engine), out of a love for the details and for figuring out how to bring a feeling to life. Jeralmi spent a summer interning at Ghost Story Games; Jeralmi's best jam game so far placed #2 for Best Gameplay at thatgamejam, run by thatgamecompany. Outside of games, Jeralmi led a youth research project for Agncy, a nonprofit design firm, on how Boston students see careers in biotech.

## Work

- Something New (in progress): lead developer, with Uhm…Games?, a studio Jeralmi runs with friends. Updates: https://x.com/Uhm_Inc
- Elevator Brawl: a 3D beat 'em up that takes place entirely in one elevator, with bosses. Lead developer. Epic MegaJam 2025. https://aquagon.itch.io/elevator-brawl
- Secret Santa Delivery: you're a cat who drives a truck delivering Secret Santa gifts. Lead developer. Comfy Jam: Winter 2026, #4 in Macrow's Picks. https://uhminc.itch.io/secret-santa-delivery
- Shaped in Stars: a 2D puzzle platformer. The world got split into two realities, and you open rifts to stitch it back together. Programmer and designer. thatgamejam #01, #2 for Best Gameplay out of 249 entries. https://lonksadventures.itch.io/shaped-in-stars
- BUILD Alumni: BUILD.org's alumni site, where former students keep in touch and find internships and scholarships. Designer and programmer. https://build.org/alumni
